title: Re-Test Hourly Rate for Work Conditioning and Work Hardening Billing
content:
# Re-test hourly rate

**Rate rule.** On a program day of the Work Conditioning Program or the Work Hardening Program under a Workers' Compensation Referral, the re-test hourly rate is one hundred fifteen dollars ($115.00) where forty-two (42) or more calendar days have passed since the latest functional capacity re-test report sent on the referral, ninety-six dollars ($96.00) where twenty-one (21) to forty-one days have passed, and the program's hourly unit rate where fewer than twenty-one days have passed or no such report has been sent.

A functional capacity re-test report is a report of the FCE kind sent on the referral; the latest one sent is the one counted from.

## Rate bands

| Calendar days since the latest functional capacity re-test report | Re-test hourly rate |
|---|---|
| 42 or more | $115.00 |
| 21 to 41 | $96.00 |
| 0 to 20 | the program's hourly unit rate |
| no such report sent on the referral | the program's hourly unit rate |

## Edges

- 20 days: the program's hourly unit rate. 21 days: $96.00.
- 41 days: $96.00. 42 days: $115.00.

## Case (hypothetical)

The latest functional capacity re-test report on a Work Hardening Program referral was sent 45 calendar days before the program day. Each billed re-test hour is priced at $115.00; two billed re-test hours come to $230.00.
